subject: Agriculture
title: Feeding the Future
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Feeding the Future.

hook.text: By 2050, we'll need to feed 10 billion people. Every solution exists. Political will is the missing ingredient.

buildup.text: Reduce waste by 50%. Shift diets toward plants. Close yield gaps in developing countries. Protect remaining farmland.

discovery.text: No single solution suffices. Feeding the future requires all of them—technology, policy, culture, and equity.

twist.text: The biggest obstacle isn't production—it's ensuring the poorest 2 billion can afford nutritious food.

climax.text: Climate change will disrupt every assumption. A food system built for stable weather must adapt to chaos.

punchline.text: We know how to feed everyone. The question is whether we choose to.

quiz.question: What is identified as the biggest obstacle to feeding 10 billion people?
options: Ensuring the poorest 2 billion can afford nutritious food
